originalTitle: Oneok Inc. (OKE) Stock Drops Despite Market Gains: Important Facts to Note
summary: In the closing of the recent trading day, Oneok Inc. (OKE) stood at $91.8, denoting a -1.78% move from the preceding trading day.
content:
Oneok Inc. (OKE) ended the recent trading session at $91.80, demonstrating a -1.78% change from the preceding day's closing price. This move lagged the S&P 500's daily gain of 1.49%. Meanwhile, the Dow gained 0.71%, and the Nasdaq, a tech-heavy index, added 2.26%.

Shares of the natural gas company have appreciated by 0.14% over the course of the past month, underperforming the Oils-Energy sector's gain of 0.51%, and outperforming the S&P 500's gain of 0.1%.

The investment community will be paying close attention to the earnings performance of Oneok Inc. in its upcoming release. The company is expected to report EPS of $1.45, down 2.68% from the prior-year quarter. Meanwhile, the Zacks Consensus Estimate for revenue is projecting net sales of $11.77 billion, up 36.34% from the year-ago period.

OKE's full-year Zacks Consensus Estimates are calling for earnings of $5.7 per share and revenue of $43.83 billion. These results would represent year-over-year changes of +5.17% and +30.34%, respectively.

Investors should also note any recent changes to analyst estimates for Oneok Inc. These latest adjustments often mirror the shifting dynamics of short-term business patterns. With this in mind, we can consider positive estimate revisions a sign of optimism about the business outlook.

Research indicates that these estimate revisions are directly correlated with near-term share price momentum. To capitalize on this, we've crafted the Zacks Rank, a unique model that incorporates these estimate changes and offers a practical rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, spanning from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), boasts an impressive track record of outperformance, audited externally, with #1 ranked stocks yielding an average annual return of +25% since 1988. Over the last 30 days, the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has moved 1.49% lower. Oneok Inc. is holding a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold) right now.

Looking at its valuation, Oneok Inc. is holding a Forward P/E ratio of 16.39. This valuation marks a premium compared to its industry average Forward P/E of 14.57.

Meanwhile, OKE's PEG ratio is currently 2.67. The PEG ratio is similar to the widely-used P/E ratio, but this metric also takes the company's expected earnings growth rate into account. The Oil and Gas - Production Pipeline - MLB industry had an average PEG ratio of 2.05 as trading concluded yesterday.

The Oil and Gas - Production Pipeline - MLB industry is part of the Oils-Energy sector. This group has a Zacks Industry Rank of 80, putting it in the top 33% of all 250+ industries.

The Zacks Industry Rank evaluates the power of our distinct industry groups by determining the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks forming the groups. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

chineseTitle: 尽管市场上涨，Oneok Inc. (OKE) 股价仍下跌：需要注意的重要事实
chineseSummary: 在最近交易日收盘时，Oneok Inc. (OKE) 股价为 91.8 美元，较前一交易日上涨 -1.78%。
chineseContent:
Oneok Inc. (OKE) 最近交易日收于 91.80 美元，较前一日收盘价上涨 -1.78%。这一举措落后于标准普尔 500 指数 1.49% 的日涨幅。与此同时，道指上涨 0.71%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上涨 2.26%。

过去一个月，这家天然气公司的股价上涨了 0.14%，跑赢石油能源板块 0.51% 的涨幅，但跑赢标准普尔 500 指数 0.1% 的涨幅。

投资界将密切关注Oneok Inc.即将发布的盈利表现。该公司预计每股收益为 1.45 美元，比去年同期下降 2.68%。与此同时，Zacks 的收入共识预计净销售额为 117.7 亿美元，比去年同期增长 36.34%。

OKE 的全年 Zacks 共识预计每股收益为 5.7 美元，收入为 438.3 亿美元。这些结果将分别代表+5.17%和+30.34%的同比变化。

投资者还应注意分析师对 Oneok Inc. 预测的近期变化。这些最新调整通常反映了短期业务模式的动态变化。考虑到这一点，我们可以认为积极的估计修正是对业务前景乐观的迹象。

研究表明，这些估计修正与近期股价动能直接相关。为了利用这一点，我们精心设计了 Zacks Rank，这是一个独特的模型，融合了这些估计变化并提供了实用的评级系统。

Zacks Rank 系统从#1（强力买入）到#5（强力卖出），拥有令人印象深刻的优异表现记录，经过外部审计，排名第一的股票自 1988 年以来平均年回报率为 +25%。在过去 30 天里，Zacks 共识 EPS 估计下降了 1.49%。 Oneok Inc . 目前的 Zacks 排名为#3（持有）。

从估值来看，Oneok Inc. 的远期市盈率为 16.39。与 14.57 的行业平均远期市盈率相比，这一估值存在溢价。

与此同时，OKE的PEG比率目前为2.67。 PEG比率与广泛使用的市盈率类似，但该指标也考虑了公司的预期盈利增长率。截至昨天交易结束，石油和天然气 - 生产管道 - MLB 行业的平均 PEG 率为 2.05。

石油和天然气 - 生产管道 - MLB 行业是石油能源行业的一部分。该集团的 Zacks 行业排名为 80，在所有 250 多个行业中排名前 33%。

Zacks 行业排名通过确定构成行业组的个股的平均 Zacks 排名来评估我们不同行业组的实力。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
